purpose: Decorative category artwork, not evidence or photographs of real projects.

prompts.technology: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original editorial project-category cover for the StepFund crowdfunding application. Landscape image, 1536 by 1024. A refined two-dimensional linocut and hand-cut paper collage, subtle irregular ink edges, flat matte colours on warm ivory uncoated paper (#f4f0e7), muted forest green (#203d32), sage, charcoal pencil details and a very small vermilion accent. Real objects drawn with coherent perspective, thoughtful sparse composition, understated European architecture journal art direction. Occupy the middle and lower two thirds, leave generous ivory breathing room around the subject for responsive cropping. No text, lettering, logos, numbers, badges, UI, frames, gradients, glossy 3D, floating coins, cryptocurrency symbols, or people. Not a photograph, not proof of a real project. Primary subject: a shared maker workshop seen at a gentle oblique angle, one sturdy dark-green workbench, small precise drill press, neatly placed hand tools, a wooden stool and one articulated desk lamp. A few red pencil marks on a sheet of paper on the bench. An architectural vignette with warmth and craft, limited details, no chaotic machinery.
